runLabel: U-PROOF (known) - Stage 4/7 - Agent 04 SEO & Content Architect

agent.name: SEO & Content Architect
agent.role: SEO architecture, page copy, metadata, internal linking

instructions:
TASK: Produce a content_pack@1 for U-Proof (South African waterproofing/building-products ecommerce company), based on the attached research_report, site_blueprint and design_system input artifacts.

THIS IS THE "KNOWN" (non-blind) SIDE of a two-project agent benchmark (CTOS-004A Part Q). Ground your SEO architecture and page copy in the real sitemap you were given (site_blueprint), the real product categories and pricing in PROJECT FACTS knowledge, and the real technical findings from research (do not invent products, prices or pages that were not given to you).

Specifically: metadata/copy for the Shop page should account for the real finding that it currently only renders 1 of 5 categories (write the copy assuming the fix lands, but do not claim in customer-facing copy that something is fixed if it is not yet); do not write page copy that repeats the wrong R500 Fibre Filler 20L price - use the real price (R1590) from PROJECT FACTS; for the fake blog-teaser articles (Surface Preparation Guide, How to Apply Liquid Rubber, FAQs) that research found were placeholder/fake, write them as REAL commissioned articles (real informative content, not placeholders) since the site_blueprint routed them under Help & Advice as real pages needing real content - flag in your own summary that you are the agent producing the real content for what was previously a fake teaser, so a human reviewer can see that gap has been closed by this pass.

Produce a content_pack@1: summary; seoArchitecture; pages (path, title, metaDescription, h1, sections) for the pages in the site_blueprint's sitemap that most need real content (Home, Shop, at least 2 product category pages, and the 3 Help & Advice articles); internalLinking.
